scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Thursday’s mobile washer diagnostic reachable by the service truck during the park’s service-lane resurfacing.
Emerging Need: The repair visit has not started, but the park now requires a free temporary contractor pass before access approvals close.
Decision Context: The booking hold and calendar record show a committed future visit; the park notice shows no pass exists, while the stored service-pass profile supplies the lot details, permit route, and no paid escort limit.
Consequence: Before approval closes, completing the missing prerequisite preserves ordinary truck access; afterward, the appointment remains on the calendar but cannot receive the intended lane clearance.

parameter.subject: Washer diagnostic slot available for Thursday
parameter.body: The intake photos are enough to offer a mobile diagnostic window for the compact washer. A Thursday, Nov. 5, 10:00 a.m.-noon window can be booked with a $45 diagnostic hold; access details can be added after the appointment is confirmed.

parameter.description: Diagnostic hold for mobile compact washer visit

parameter.title: Sooner Appliance mobile washer diagnostic
parameter.description: Compact washer diagnostic; $45 diagnostic hold posted. Access notes to be finalized before visit.

parameter.subject: Nov. 5 service-lane resurfacing and contractor passes
parameter.body: On Thursday, Nov. 5, the west service lane will be under resurfacing from 7:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Contractor vehicles may use the lane only if a free temporary contractor pass is approved in advance. The current roster shows no pass for your home. Resident requests need the lease name, lot number, contractor name, visit window, and vehicle purpose by 3:00 p.m. today; late or paid escort requests are handled on a separate after-hours list.

parameter.subject: Contractor pass approvals closed for Nov. 5 west lane
parameter.body: Today's temporary contractor-pass approvals for Thursday service-lane access closed at 3:00 p.m. The Nov. 5 roster was issued without an appliance-repair pass for your home, so unapproved contractor vehicles will be held at the front lot until resurfacing clears after 5:00 p.m.
